name: threat-intel-synthesis
description: Turn raw threat intelligence — news feeds, knowledge graphs, vendor advisories, and incident teardowns — into structured attack patterns, reconstructed incident narratives, and attack-surface coverage maps that drive detection and control decisions. Triggers for: threat intel analysis, attack pattern extraction, incident reconstruction, "what actually happened" analysis, ATT&CK mapping from reporting, threat landscape review, coverage gap analysis, intel-driven detection engineering, or weekly threat recap.
